description: Qwen3-1.7B fine-tuned on PNS-filtered Qwen3-14B CoT chains. Only causally necessary steps (PS=1, PNS>0.5) are retained. Produces more concise reasoning with 52.1 fewer tokens per response than the noncausal baseline.

training.data_source: Qwen3-14B PNS-filtered chains (PS=1, alpha=0.5, k=3 rollouts)

key_finding: PNS-pruned training data produces measurably more concise generation: 52.1 fewer tokens per response on GSM-8k versus noncausal SFT, confirming that causal step selection transfers from training data to inference behaviour.
